title: Text: DET Chad Crunk ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Hey are you around? I’m about to leave, trying to understand what your email is about
The story reads as if you’re saying that all four doctors recommended that cabrera have surgery. I’m out by the field
“But by not opting for surgery, which all four specialists surveyed recommended, the knee issue is forecast to linger.”
They recommended him not to have surgery right?
Right, but the way that I read and I had several others read it too and they all thought you were saying that the specialists recommended he have surgery
